وَٱلطُّورِ
وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

parent_channels.name: P1 Written Determination Acquires Force

subchannels.name: The Published Record
subchannels.scene_or_process: Joined folios receive ruled inscription on parchment and are opened as a public writ.
subchannels.active_motifs: stitched joining `quranic:root_001283:B001/m02`; written inscription `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; ruled rows `quranic:root_000704:B001/m01`; writing parchment `quranic:root_000586:B002/m01`; published writ `quranic:root_001503:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:2 - ك ت ب, س ط ر; 52:3 - ر ق ق, ن ش ر.
subchannels.synthesis: The book is not only information but a fabricated, ordered, and exposed artifact. Joining, lineation, parchment, and publication turn the oath-object into a record made ready for enactment.

subchannels.name: Decree Becomes Event
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding decree receives final authentication and lands as a fixed occurrence.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding decree `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`; fixed occurrence `quranic:root_001675:B001/m02`; writer's signature `quranic:root_001675:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The written determination and the event are two stages of one operation: what has been bound as decree is signed into effect and can no longer be repelled.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A determination becomes effective by being materially fixed, exposed, and fulfilled.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:2-3 presents writing on an opened sheet, while 52:7 declares the promised event unavoidable.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Scribal craft and signature imagery make the punishment's وقوع resemble execution of an authenticated record.

parent_channels.name: P1 Supports and Vessels Unfastened

subchannels.name: Inhabited Roofwork
subchannels.scene_or_process: A repaired and inhabited shelter remains usable beneath a raised roof.
subchannels.active_motifs: sheltering house `quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`; restoration and inhabitation `quranic:root_001044:B003/m01`; structural roof `quranic:root_000720:B001/m01`; elevation `quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:4 - ب ي ت, ع م ر; 52:5 - س ق ف, ر ف ع.
subchannels.synthesis: The paired house and roof evoke maintained occupancy rather than isolated monuments. Habitation is sustained by repaired fabric and an elevated covering, establishing the stable architecture that the later upheaval will invert.

subchannels.name: Basin Charged as Furnace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A water-gathering depression is filled to capacity and then activated as a fire chamber.
subchannels.active_motifs: sea water `quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`; catchment basin `quranic:root_000086:B006/m01`; filling with water `quranic:root_000676:B001/m01`; kindling fire `quranic:root_000676:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:6 - ب ح ر, س ج ر.
subchannels.synthesis: The same vessel can be read hydraulically and pyrotechnically: the basin gathers and fills, then its stored content becomes fuel. Containment does not disappear; it changes operation from reservoir to furnace.

subchannels.name: Fastened Heights Put in Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: The overhead expanse oscillates while mountain solidity and bedrock resistance give way to displacement.
subchannels.active_motifs: overhead sky `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; wave-like oscillation `quranic:root_001456:B001/m01`; raised solid mass `quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`; bedrock that stops digging `quranic:root_000217:B005/m01`; directed movement `quranic:root_000769:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:9 - س م و, م و ر; 52:10 - ج ب ل, س ي ر.
subchannels.synthesis: Sky and mountain represent opposite bearings, one overhead and one resistant below. Oscillation and travel convert both from fixed coordinates into moving matter, materializing the loss of cosmic orientation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Habitable order depends on roofs, basins, and solid bearings whose containment is reversed at the event.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:4-6 names an inhabited house, raised roof, and filled or kindled sea, followed by the sky's convulsion and mountains' motion in 52:9-10.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Architecture, hydraulic storage, combustion, and bedrock form one material model of a world whose load-bearing arrangements are released.

parent_channels.name: P1 Denial Forced Into Its Own Proof

subchannels.name: Failed Repulsion Becomes Forced Conveyance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Defenders cannot push the event away and are instead violently driven, like a rebuked herd, into the fire.
subchannels.active_motifs: repulsion and defense `quranic:root_000480:B001/m01`; violent shove `quranic:root_000477:B001/m01`; herding call and rebuke `quranic:root_000477:B003/m01`; entering or meeting fire `quranic:root_000880:B003/m01`; kindled fire `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The direction of force reverses. The attempt to repel punishment becomes the condition of being driven toward it, and the repeated shove acquires the concrete rhythm of moving a resistant herd.

subchannels.name: Illumination Cancels the Sorcery Defense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Denial labels the disclosure deceptive, but fire-light places the evidence directly before sight and insight.
subchannels.active_motifs: denial or accusation of falsehood `quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`; deceptive diversion `quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`; visual sight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inward discernment `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; illumination `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:14 - ك ذ ب, ن و ر; 52:15 - س ح ر, ب ص ر.
subchannels.synthesis: The charge of sorcery proposes a manipulated appearance, while sight and illumination demand direct recognition. The punishment therefore functions as counterproof: the alleged illusion is what finally exposes the earlier denial.

subchannels.name: Endurance Equalized by Recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Whether one holds firm or not, an inescapable condition remains and the result is made equal to intentional work.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding oneself firm `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; distress with no exit `quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`; equality `quranic:root_000766:B001/m01`; recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; intentional action `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:16 - ص ب ر, س و ي, ج ز ي, ع م ل.
subchannels.synthesis: Patience normally changes how hardship is borne, but here it cannot create an exit. Equality does not flatten responsibility; it fixes consequence to the work that produced it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Denial loses agency when repulsion fails, sensory exposure becomes unavoidable, and outcome is matched exactly to action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:8 and 52:13-16 move from failed defense to forced entry, visual confrontation, and recompense.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Herding, illumination, and equalization recast judgment as compelled transport into an evidentiary scene.

parent_channels.name: P2 Provision Under Protection

subchannels.name: The Fortified Garden
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cultivated enclosure doubles as a shielded space in which a nurtured good state is preserved.
subchannels.active_motifs: cultivated garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; shielding enclosure `quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`; protective barrier `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`; self-protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`; nurturing completion `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`; bestowed good state `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:17 - ج ن ن, و ق ي, ن ع م; 52:18 - ر ب ب, و ق ي.
subchannels.synthesis: Garden and shield are complementary operations of the same enclosure. Cultivation produces the good state, while guarding prevents the surrounding punishment from entering it.

subchannels.name: The Extending Supply Line
subchannels.scene_or_process: Gifts reach the table through joined reinforcement and a water-fed line that sustains fruit and meat.
subchannels.active_motifs: brought gift `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; water channel `quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`; connected reinforcement and supply `quranic:root_001407:B002/m01`; feeder water joining another source `quranic:root_001407:B003/m01`; fruit `quranic:root_001174:B002/m01`; meat `quranic:root_001348:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:18 - ء ت ي, ف ك ه; 52:22 - م د د, ف ك ه, ل ح م.
subchannels.synthesis: Bestowal is rendered as delivery infrastructure. The extension of provision and the extension of water share a joined-source mechanism, so abundance appears continuously fed rather than merely piled up.

subchannels.name: Effortless Ingestion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food and drink pass into the body pleasantly, without hardship, while remaining related to prior work.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; drinking `quranic:root_000783:B001/m01`; consequence-free pleasantness `quranic:root_001604:B001/m01`; intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:19 - ء ك ل, ش ر ب, ه ن ء, ع م ل.
subchannels.synthesis: The reward is bodily but not burdensome: ingestion has taste and satisfaction without the aftereffects that ordinarily accompany consumption. Its ease is not arbitrary, because the verse still ties it to purposive action.

subchannels.name: The Clean Cup Exchange
subchannels.scene_or_process: Drink is passed reciprocally and finishes cleanly, leaving neither discarded speech nor guilt that delays good.
subchannels.active_motifs: drinking cup `quranic:root_001277:B001/m01`; reciprocal passing `quranic:root_001489:B006/m01`; clean finish of a drink `quranic:root_001489:B011/m01`; what is discarded from account `quranic:root_001361:B001/m01`; delay from good and guilt `quranic:root_000013:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:23 - ن ز ع, ك ء س, ل غ و, ء ث م.
subchannels.synthesis: The cup circulates socially without producing verbal waste or moral arrears. Its clean ending extends from taste to consequence, completing the protected economy of provision.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Good provision is enclosed, continuously supplied, and consumed without harmful residue.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:17-23 joins guarded gardens, bestowed food and drink, extended supply, and a cup free of corrupt consequence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fortification, irrigation, ingestion, and cup exchange disclose a complete provisioning system rather than a loose inventory of rewards.

parent_channels.name: P2 Proximity Put in Order

subchannels.name: Aligned Repose and Pairing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reclinings are placed in rows, paired companionship, and a coordinated field of attentive eyes.
subchannels.active_motifs: reclining support `quranic:root_001678:B004/m01`; couch `quranic:root_000697:B011/m01`; row and alignment `quranic:root_000871:B001/m01`; pairing `quranic:root_000652:B001/m01`; contrasting eye `quranic:root_000369:B001/m01`; wide beautiful eyes `quranic:root_001069:B016/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:20 - و ك ء, س ر ر, ص ف ف, ز و ج, ح و ر, ع ي ن.
subchannels.synthesis: Rest is coordinated rather than solitary. Rows stabilize bodies, pairing establishes relation, and the eye imagery supplies reciprocal attention within the ordered assembly.

subchannels.name: Orbiting Service and Preserved Pearls
subchannels.scene_or_process: Young attendants circle the assembly like protected pearls whose enclosure preserves their luster.
subchannels.active_motifs: circular movement `quranic:root_000957:B001/m01`; youthful attendant `quranic:root_001103:B001/m01`; pearl `quranic:root_001337:B001/m01`; pearly gleam `quranic:root_001337:B002/m01`; protective concealment `quranic:root_001324:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:24 - ط و ف, غ ل م, ل ء ل ء, ك ن ن.
subchannels.synthesis: Service is pictured as an orbit around a settled center. The pearl comparison adds preserved brightness, so movement around the gathering remains part of its protected order.

subchannels.name: Face-to-Face Mutual Inquiry
subchannels.scene_or_process: Members of the gathering turn toward one another and exchange questions and speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: mutual facing `quranic:root_001198:B001/m01`; members or parts of a whole `quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`; reciprocal questioning `quranic:root_000661:B004/m01`; spoken word `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:25 - ق ب ل, ب ع ض, س ء ل; 52:26 - ق و ل.
subchannels.synthesis: Spatial facing becomes a discourse relation. Distinct members remain identifiable, but their orientation allows remembered experience to be jointly examined rather than privately retained.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Blessed society is arranged through alignment, protected circulation, and mutual facing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:20 and 52:24-26 order reclining companions, circulating attendants, and face-to-face inquiry.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Rows, orbits, gleaming enclosures, and reciprocal orientation translate social harmony into spatial geometry.

parent_channels.name: P2 Household Continuity Without Transferred Debt

subchannels.name: Descendants Attached Without Reduction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Later offspring follow, catch up, and are joined as kin without diminishing the first generation.
subchannels.active_motifs: faith and certainty `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; following `quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`; small scattered progeny `quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`; catching up `quranic:root_001347:B001/m01`; later growth following the first crop `quranic:root_001347:B003/m01`; reduction `quranic:root_000044:B001/m01`; kinship bond `quranic:root_000552:B002/m01`; kinship tissue `quranic:root_001348:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:21 - ء م ن, ت ب ع, ذ ر ر, ل ح ق, ء ل ت; 52:22 - ل ح م; 52:28 - ر ح م.
subchannels.synthesis: Descendants are subsequent issue that reaches an earlier body without taking from it. The plant-like later crop and bodily kinship tissue make attachment additive rather than subtractive.

subchannels.name: Each Person Retained as Collateral
subchannels.scene_or_process: Every complete person remains pledged by what that person intentionally acquires.
subchannels.active_motifs: encompassing each and all `quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`; individual person `quranic:root_001409:B001/m01`; acquisition `quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`; collateral pledge `quranic:root_000607:B001/m01`; intentional action `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:21 - ك ل ل, م ر ء, ك س ب, ر ه ن, ع م ل.
subchannels.synthesis: Joining households does not merge accounts. The collateral image preserves a one-to-one relation between person, acquisition, and liability inside the wider promise of reunion.

subchannels.name: Gestational Preparation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Concealed offspring develop through reproductive readiness, prebirth milk, and udders arranged for feeding.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealed fetus `quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`; breeding-ready female camel `quranic:root_000009:B012/m01`; prebirth milk near delivery `quranic:root_001174:B004/m01`; gathered udders for milking `quranic:root_000871:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The vocabulary of enclosure, coming, fruitfulness, and rows converges on preparation for birth and nourishment. This embodied precursor gives generational attachment a developmental process rather than treating descendants as an abstract category.

subchannels.name: Delivery, Reception, and Aftercare
subchannels.scene_or_process: Labor produces young, a receiver meets the birth, and womb, pain, and postpartum discharge mark its completion.
subchannels.active_motifs: laboring camel `quranic:root_001678:B006/m01`; newborn camel calf `quranic:root_000369:B008/m01`; womb `quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`; postpartum pain `quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`; postpartum discharge `quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`; receiver or midwife `quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The lineage channel reaches its concrete threshold in labor and reception. Birth creates real continuity through the body, while the separate receiver and aftercare preserve differentiated roles rather than collapsing household members into one identity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Generational continuity is joined and embodied, while moral liability remains attached to each acting person.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:21 joins descendants to believers without reduction yet pledges every person by acquisition, and 52:25-28 returns to household memory and mercy.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Kinship tissue and a dense gestation-to-delivery sequence materialize attachment while clarifying why attachment does not erase individual account.

parent_channels.name: P3 Speech Put on Trial

subchannels.name: Rival Classifications of the Speaker
subchannels.scene_or_process: One act of reminder is redescribed as hidden-news divination, covered reason, or poetic craft.
subchannels.active_motifs: reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; diviner claiming hidden news `quranic:root_001327:B001/m01`; reason covered by madness `quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`; poet and measured verse `quranic:root_000798:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:29 - ذ ك ر, ك ه ن, ج ن ن; 52:30 - ش ع ر.
subchannels.synthesis: The labels do not merely insult; each assigns a different production mechanism to the same speech. The reminder is thereby placed among rival explanations whose incompatibility exposes their tactical character.

subchannels.name: Waiting Until the Cutter Arrives
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opponents hold the matter like ware awaiting a better market while feared turns of time end the waiting by cutting duration short.
subchannels.active_motifs: watchful waiting `quranic:root_000534:B001/m01`; ware withheld for market change `quranic:root_000534:B002/m01`; doubt `quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`; feared turns of time `quranic:root_000616:B002/m01`; time or death as cutter `quranic:root_001449:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:30 - ر ب ص, ر ي ب, م ن ن; 52:31 - ر ب ص.
subchannels.synthesis: Delay becomes speculative hoarding: the accusers wait for events to devalue the messenger. Yet the same temporal field contains the cutter that ends their leverage, reversing waiting from strategy into exposure.

subchannels.name: Reason Commands Its Own Overflow
subchannels.scene_or_process: Claimed reason issues a command or counsel whose outcome is precisely the excess that reason should restrain.
subchannels.active_motifs: reason and restraint `quranic:root_000352:B001/m01`; command `quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`; counsel `quranic:root_000051:B007/m01`; overstepping bounds `quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`; engulfing flood force `quranic:root_000937:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:32 - ح ل م, ء م ر, ط غ ي.
subchannels.synthesis: The verse sets up an operational contradiction. If their reason is the commander, its product is not restraint but an overflowing force that destroys the very boundary rational judgment should maintain.

subchannels.name: Fabricated Authorship Meets the Imitation Test
subchannels.scene_or_process: False attribution of newly produced speech is answered by a demand to bring an imitating discourse that verifies the claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: attributing words never spoken `quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`; renewed speech or report `quranic:root_000299:B003/m01`; imitation after a model `quranic:root_001397:B010/m01`; bringing a thing forward `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; truthful speech `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`; verification and fulfillment `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:33 - ق و ل; 52:34 - ء ت ي, ح د ث, م ث ل, ص د ق.
subchannels.synthesis: The accusation is converted from description into production protocol. If the discourse is fabricated after a model, the accusers must reproduce that operation; failure to do so leaves their truth claim unverified.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Competing descriptions of the messenger become claims that can be tested by time, reason, and counterproduction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:29-34 moves through labels of diviner, madman, and poet to waiting, alleged fabrication, and the demand for comparable speech.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Commodity hoarding, time's cutting action, and flood force materialize the failure of rhetorical delay and self-styled reason.

parent_channels.name: P3 The Unauthorized Cosmic Office

subchannels.name: Measured Making of Upper and Lower Realms
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowable things and the upper and lower realms require measuring and creation rather than self-origination from no maker.
subchannels.active_motifs: measured determination `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; creation `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; knowable thing `quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`; otherness or absence of another `quranic:root_001119:B005/m01`; overhead sky `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; lower ground `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; certainty `quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:35 - خ ل ق, غ ي ر, ش ي ء; 52:36 - خ ل ق, س م و, ء ر ض, ي ق ن.
subchannels.synthesis: Creation is presented as measured formation of determinate things and ordered levels. The alternatives of self-making or makerless emergence fail to account for the relation between formed object, upper realm, lower realm, and certainty.

subchannels.name: Treasury Custody and Control
subchannels.scene_or_process: Secure stores require an owner, keeper, and supervising controller who possesses their contents.
subchannels.active_motifs: possession and proximity `quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`; secure store `quranic:root_000406:B001/m01`; keeper of stores `quranic:root_000406:B003/m01`; owning master `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; supervising controller `quranic:root_000704:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:37 - ع ن د, خ ز ن, ر ب ب, س ط ر.
subchannels.synthesis: A treasury is an office, not merely a stockpile. Ownership, secured contents, custodianship, and supervision must coincide, and the challengers occupy none of those roles.

subchannels.name: Ladder Audition and Public Proof
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claimant ascends by a means of access, hears and understands privileged information, then brings a clear warrant of authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: ladder or means of ascent `quranic:root_000737:B006/m01`; hearing `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; understanding and compliance `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; bringing evidence `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; proof `quranic:root_000732:B002/m01`; authority `quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`; clarity `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:38 - س ل م, س م ع, ء ت ي, س ل ط, ب ي ن.
subchannels.synthesis: Private audition is insufficient by itself. The ascent must produce understood content and then descend into a publicly legible proof that carries authority.

subchannels.name: Reproductive Apportionment Without Generative Control
subchannels.scene_or_process: Lineage is assigned by gender despite the embodied stages of creation, concealed gestation, visible pregnancy, and possible loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: lineage and children `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; creation `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; concealed fetus `quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`; pregnancy's load `quranic:root_000202:B007/m01`; pregnancy becoming visible `quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`; miscarriage `quranic:root_000719:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The surface apportionment of daughters and sons is pressured by a latent reproductive sequence. Naming preferred lineage does not confer control over formation, gestation, visibility, delivery, or loss.

subchannels.name: Fee Converted Into Burden
subchannels.scene_or_process: A demand for payment would turn the audience into debtors carrying a slow, oppressive liability.
subchannels.active_motifs: demanding payment `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; wage or fee `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; financial liability `quranic:root_001081:B001/m01`; heaviness and slowing `quranic:root_000202:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:40 - س ء ل, ء ج ر, غ ر م, ث ق ل.
subchannels.synthesis: The question tests motive by following fee to its social outcome. A demanded wage would become the hearers' liability and impede them; the absence of that burden removes a transactional explanation for the message.

subchannels.name: The Unseen Archive
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hidden knowledge would have to be possessed, inscribed, and fixed as a governing record.
subchannels.active_motifs: possession `quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`; hidden or absent knowledge `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`; writing `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; binding decree `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:41 - ع ن د, غ ي ب, ك ت ب.
subchannels.synthesis: The unseen is framed as an archive only an authorized possessor could write from. The challengers' claims lack both access to hidden content and the power to bind it into decree.

subchannels.name: Deity Without Partnership
subchannels.scene_or_process: Exclusive worship excludes both an alternative deity and any partnership in divine office.
subchannels.active_motifs: deity and worship `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; otherness `quranic:root_001119:B005/m01`; partnership `quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`; association in worship `quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`; declaring transcendence from attribution `quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:43 - ء ل ه, غ ي ر, ش ر ك, س ب ح.
subchannels.synthesis: The sequence of authority tests terminates at the office itself. Neither another object of worship nor a partner can supply the missing powers, and transcendence clears the divine office of the proposed association.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Claims to judge revelation are tested against the powers of origin, custody, access, account, hidden inscription, and exclusive worship.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:35-43 asks whether the challengers create, own treasuries, hear by ascent, assign divine lineage, demand fees, write the unseen, or possess another deity.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Administrative, reproductive, evidentiary, and financial operations specify what cosmic authority would actually require.

parent_channels.name: P3 Counterplot and Interpretive Collapse

subchannels.name: The Snare Returns on Its Maker
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deliberate handling constructs a covered plot that functions like a hunter's snare for those who set it.
subchannels.active_motifs: intention and seeking `quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`; strenuous handling `quranic:root_001334:B001/m01`; plotted maneuver `quranic:root_001334:B002/m01`; covering `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; denial `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; hunter's snare `quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:42 - ر و د, ك ي د, ك ف ر; 52:43 - ش ر ك.
subchannels.synthesis: Plotting is not disembodied cunning but worked construction under cover. The hunter's apparatus clarifies the reversal: those who deliberately arrange capture become the ones caught in their own concealed operation.

subchannels.name: Falling Fragment Reclassified as Cloud
subchannels.scene_or_process: Observers see a fragment falling from above but verbally recode it as an ordinary cloud dragged into a pile.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual seeing `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; separated fragment `quranic:root_001298:B004/m01`; overhead sky `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; falling `quranic:root_000719:B001/m01`; perceptual or verbal error `quranic:root_000719:B003/m01`; spoken classification `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; dragged cloud `quranic:root_000680:B002/m01`; piled mass `quranic:root_000595:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:44 - ر ء ي, ك س ف, س م و, س ق ط, ق و ل, س ح ب, ر ك م.
subchannels.synthesis: The eyes register descent correctly, but interpretation domesticates the threat by assigning it familiar cloud mechanics. Seeing therefore does not guarantee recognition; speech can convert a falling sign into weather.

subchannels.name: Encounter With the Stunning Event
subchannels.scene_or_process: The opponents are left until they meet a momentous event whose aerial crash produces shock, unconsciousness, or death.
subchannels.active_motifs: leaving in place `quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`; confronting encounter `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; meeting harm `quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`; momentous event `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; aerial crash `quranic:root_000864:B002/m01`; stunned or lifeless state `quranic:root_000864:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:45 - و ذ ر, ل ق ي, ي و م, ص ع ق.
subchannels.synthesis: Being left is temporary, not release. It preserves the opponents for a direct encounter in which the event arrives as both external impact and internal loss of consciousness or life.

subchannels.name: Plot Without Sufficiency or Aid
subchannels.scene_or_process: At the decisive event, planning can neither substitute for what is needed nor summon effective support.
subchannels.active_motifs: momentous event `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; sufficiency or substitution `quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`; plotted maneuver `quranic:root_001334:B002/m01`; any knowable thing `quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`; aid `quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:46 - ي و م, غ ن ي, ك ي د, ش ي ء, ن ص ر.
subchannels.synthesis: Strategy fails in two distinct functions: it cannot stand in for the need, and it cannot recruit help. The event strips the plot of both intrinsic efficacy and external reinforcement.

subchannels.name: Nearer Punishment Beneath Unknowing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Withheld right generates a claim for justice while punishment already lies near or below, though most do not know it.
subchannels.active_motifs: grievance and demand for redress `quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`; withholding a right `quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`; punitive pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; nearness or lower position `quranic:root_000502:B001/m01`; plurality `quranic:root_001286:B001/m01`; knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:47 - ظ ل م, ع ذ ب, د و ن, ك ث ر, ع ل م.
subchannels.synthesis: The additional punishment is not merely later; it is already spatially or causally near. Injustice has generated its answering claim, but plurality does not produce awareness of the consequence gathering below it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Attempts to control the outcome fail at every stage: intention becomes entrapment, perception becomes misreading, and neither planning nor knowledge supplies escape.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:42-47 moves from plotting through a misread falling fragment to encounter, failed aid, and an unrecognized nearer punishment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A hunter's snare and the mechanics of dragged, piled cloud turn strategic and interpretive failure into concrete operations.

parent_channels.name: P3 Disciplined Motion Under Watch

subchannels.name: Judgment Held Under the Eye
subchannels.scene_or_process: The messenger holds firm within a ruling that restrains and orders, under the owner's active watch.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding oneself firm `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; restraint and reform `quranic:root_000348:B001/m01`; judgment `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; owning master `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; watchful care `quranic:root_001069:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:48 - ص ب ر, ح ك م, ر ب ب, ع ي ن.
subchannels.synthesis: Patience is participation in an already governed process, not passive delay. Judgment supplies the ordering boundary, while the eye converts sovereignty into immediate care and supervision.

subchannels.name: Scheduled Standing Praise
subchannels.scene_or_process: Praise is assigned a time and enacted by rising or standing to the appointed task.
subchannels.active_motifs: worshipful glorification `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`; praise `quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`; determinate time `quranic:root_000382:B001/m01`; assigning a time to an act `quranic:root_000382:B003/m01`; standing `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`; rising to a task `quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:48 - س ب ح, ح م د, ح ي ن, ق و م.
subchannels.synthesis: The command coordinates posture and time. Rising is not incidental movement but the bodily commencement of an appointed act of praise.

subchannels.name: Night and Stars Recede in Ordered Swimming
subchannels.scene_or_process: Through the night, celestial bodies swim their courses until the following star and the star field recede and the sky clears.
subchannels.active_motifs: night `quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`; celestial swimming `quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`; recession and ending `quranic:root_000458:B002/m01`; the star following the Pleiades `quranic:root_000458:B013/m01`; star `quranic:root_001475:B001/m01`; sky clearing as stars appear `quranic:root_001475:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 52:49 - ل ي ل, س ب ح, د ب ر, ن ج م.
subchannels.synthesis: Night worship is synchronized with an astronomical process. Swimming, following, recession, and clearing render the stars as an ordered moving cohort whose obedience mirrors the timed human act.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Endurance, worship, and celestial recession are timed forms of ordered motion under sovereign care.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 52:48-49 commands patient continuance under the divine eye and praise at rising, night, and the recession of stars.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Judicial restraint, scheduled standing, and stellar swimming make obedience a coordinated temporal and kinetic order.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 Wading Talk as Play
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Speakers enter discourse as if wading into water, stir it like a drink, and remain occupied in purposeless play.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wading into water `quranic:root_000446:B001/m01`; entering talk `quranic:root_000446:B002/m01`; stirring a drink `quranic:root_000446:B003/m01`; purposeless play `quranic:root_001358:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 52:12 - خ و ض, ل ع ب.
parent_channels.synthesis: The speech activity acquires depth, resistance, and agitation. Wading and stirring show participation that muddies its medium, while play identifies the absence of a serious end.

parent_channels.name: S2. P2 Anxious Household Recollected Under Mercy
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A household recalls its former protective anxiety and traces its safety through grace, calling, kin-kindness, and mercy.
parent_channels.active_motifs: prior time `quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`; household `quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`; care mixed with fear `quranic:root_000803:B003/m01`; gracious benefaction `quranic:root_001449:B003/m01`; protection `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`; calling `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; kindness to kin `quranic:root_000104:B003/m01`; mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`.

parent_channels.synthesis: The household's earlier fear is not erased but reinterpreted. Protective concern becomes the remembered condition from which benefaction, prayer, kin-directed goodness, and mercy can be recognized as one rescue sequence.

parent_channels.name: S3. Woven Cloth That Lies by Appearance
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Strong yarn is expertly interlaced with weft and saturated with color, yet the patterned surface can misreport a fabric whose pile is wearing away.
parent_channels.active_motifs: yarn-rich strong cloth `quranic:root_000043:B012/m01`; expert weaving and spinning `quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`; weft completing the warp `quranic:root_001348:B006/m01`; dye permeating fabric `quranic:root_000783:B007/m01`; colored cloth that lies by its condition `quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`; worn cloth losing its nap `quranic:root_000434:B009/m01`.

This materially pressures the surah's accusations of fabricated speech and its recoding of a falling fragment as cloud: color and pattern can "lie," while structure and wear disclose the artifact's actual condition.

parent_channels.name: S4. Making and Sealing a Leather Water Skin
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hide is tanned, stitched into a vessel, conditioned so its seams close, and secured with a leather thong while any thin leaking point is watched.

This materializes the guarded provision of P2 and usefully pressures claims of security in P1, where defenses fail when the enclosing order can no longer hold.

parent_channels.name: S5. The Working Well-Pulley
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A water-holding hollow is fitted with an upright frame, turning axle, and handle so a suspended bucket can draw water to a drinking place.
parent_channels.active_motifs: newly cut well or water-holding hollow `quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`; upright pulley component `quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`; rotation on an axle `quranic:root_000369:B007/m01`; handle and iron pulley spindle `quranic:root_000610:B006/m01`; water drawn by hand or suspended bucket `quranic:root_001489:B008/m01`; drinking place or vessel `quranic:root_000783:B004/m01`.

This reframes the ladder challenge of 52:38: authentic access needs support, rotation, drawing, and delivery from a concealed source, just as privileged hearing must return with a clear warrant.

parent_channels.name: S6. Wedding House, Song, and Feast
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A couple forms a nuptial household, enters the wedding house, and marks the union with pleasant song and ceremonial feeding.
parent_channels.active_motifs: taking a spouse `quranic:root_000064:B002/m01`; nuptial pair `quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`; entering upon the bride `quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`; wedding house `quranic:root_000166:B010/m01`; pleasant singing and listening `quranic:root_000741:B007/m01`; sung voice `quranic:root_001110:B003/m01`; food served at a wedding `quranic:root_001410:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Pairing, household, sound, and food assemble into a recognizable social rite. This reframes P2's companions, table, circulating cup, and reunited family as the formation and celebration of a stable household rather than an inventory of isolated pleasures.

parent_channels.name: S7. Sharpening and Polishing a Blade
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hard blade that has lost its edge is whetted on stone, polished, and restored to a sharp cutting point.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hard iron or sword `quranic:root_000516:B002/m01`; dulled blade `quranic:root_001315:B001/m01`; whetting iron on stone `quranic:root_001675:B009/m01`; polishing a sword `quranic:root_000299:B007/m01`; sharp elongated point `quranic:root_000732:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The maintenance cycle materializes the surah's contest over verbal and strategic force: accusations can be honed and polished to appear cutting. It also pressures that posture, because 52:46 denies plotting any effective edge when the decreed وقوع, evoked here as the act of sharpening, finally lands.

parent_channels.name: S8. Gaming Arrows and the Losing Wager
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Gaming arrows are gathered in their leather case, property or persons are risked, and one marked outcome leaves a loser.
parent_channels.active_motifs: case holding gaming arrows `quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`; losing gaming arrow and its loser `quranic:root_000458:B019/m01`; wagered stake `quranic:root_000607:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene reframes the opponents' waiting and plotting as a speculative wager on the messenger's defeat. It usefully pressures that strategy because the promised decree is not a chance draw: the wagerer is already pledged to the losing outcome rather than controlling it.

parent_channels.name: S9. Rain-Restored Pasture and a Convalescing Herd
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Rain revives dry grazing land; dense new growth feeds an emaciated, immobilized animal until it recovers and settles.

parent_channels.synthesis: Provision here restores capacity rather than merely adding luxury: renewed ground releases the wasted animal from fixed weakness into feeding, recovery, and rest. This materializes P2's garden and protection as convalescence after the fear and wasting pressure associated with punishment.

parent_channels.name: S10. Burial Lodging and Return to Life
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The dead person is concealed in an assigned grave-house and hidden from view, but the burial ends in renewed life.
parent_channels.active_motifs: grave as a house `quranic:root_000166:B007/m01`; shrouding and concealing the dead `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; grave assigned to the deceased `quranic:root_000607:B006/m01`; burial as hiding `quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`; revival of the dead `quranic:root_001503:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Burial is an interim lodging and concealment, not a terminal disappearance. This directly supports the surah's promised encounter with judgment: the same ن ش ر root that surfaces in the opened scroll also activates renewed life, so the decree's publication is matched by the bringing forth of those hidden in graves.

parent_channels.name: S11. P1-P2-P3 Deferred Freedom Under Measured Conditions
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person enters a written self-purchase contract whose installments are measured, while a contrasting legal instrument delays release until the owner's death.
parent_channels.active_motifs: enslaved status `quranic:root_000586:B003/m01`; written installment contract for manumission `quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`; standard dry measure `quranic:root_001407:B006/m01`; known weighed measure `quranic:root_001449:B005/m01`; manumission triggered after the owner's death `quranic:root_000458:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Bridge (P1 -> P2 -> P3): the shared legal invariant is a status reversal held in abeyance until a stated future condition, with a contrast between measured contractual performance and release triggered by death. P1 supplies the bound person and written instrument, P2 supplies installment measurement, and P3 carries measurement into the terminal alternative. This role progression usefully pressures the surah's sequence of decree, individual earning, and final judgment: accountable action has determinate weight, but release cannot be improvised, bought from the messenger, or altered by plotting; it occurs only under the governing condition.

parent_channels.name: S12. Powdered Poison and Bodily Wasting
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A powdered substance becomes the vehicle for lethal poison placed in food or introduced into the body, after which the victim wastes away.
parent_channels.active_motifs: powdered aromatic substance `quranic:root_000511:B003/m01`; lethal poison entering the body or food `quranic:root_000743:B002/m01`; bodily wasting and emaciation `quranic:root_001347:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Poison turns provision into an inward route of harm, with wasting as its visible bodily result. This materializes protection from the punishment of al-samum in 52:27 as rescue from a penetrating toxin, and it sharpens the contrast with P2's protected food supply: what enters the blessed body nourishes rather than secretly consumes it.

parent_channels.name: S13. Incision, Suppuration, and Flesh Closure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An incision reaches living flesh; pus gathers and can corrupt the lesion, while the counter-process is the flesh closing and healing.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cutting flesh and incising a wound `quranic:root_001638:B002/m01`; wound reaching flesh and closing in healing `quranic:root_001348:B008/m01`; pus extending through a wound `quranic:root_001407:B007/m01`; ulcer festering with pus `quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene follows one injury into opposed outcomes: tissue can knit shut, or hidden suppuration can advance into visible corruption. It usefully pressures the apparent delay of 52:45-47, because deferred encounter need not mean inactive harm; punishment can already be developing like an untreated wound, while P2's protected provision aligns with the bodily alternative of closure and repair.

parent_channels.name: S14. Battle Turns Into the Combatant's Death Struggle
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A contest framed as war enters violent collision, blazes into killing, reduces the slain to flesh, and terminates in the soul's struggle and death throes.
parent_channels.active_motifs: war and combat `quranic:root_001334:B004/m01`; battle clash and striking the enemy `quranic:root_001675:B005/m01`; battle blazing with severe killing `quranic:root_000225:B002/m01`; killing until the slain become flesh `quranic:root_001348:B004/m01`; soul struggling to leave the body `quranic:root_001334:B003/m01`; death throes `quranic:root_001489:B016/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The same ك ي د root reverses the combatant's role: the word-field moves from waging war to the soul's losing struggle to depart. The sequence materializes the failure of plotting in 52:42-46 as a battle whose makers cannot control its final encounter; strategic aggression collapses into the plotters' own bodily defeat.

parent_channels.name: S15. Meat Preservation Between Nourishment and Spoilage
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Meat is stripped from bone and laid out in rows in the sun or over coals for use or travel, but its intended nourishment remains vulnerable to turning and stench.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stripping meat from bone `quranic:root_001348:B009/m01`; meat arrayed for drying or travel `quranic:root_000871:B003/m01`; meat changing and becoming foul `quranic:root_000406:B004/m01`; food building bodily flesh `quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Ordinary meat requires extraction, arrangement, heat, and vigilance against decay before it can build the body. This reframes the desired meat supplied in 52:22 as provision freed from processing burden and spoilage risk, so P2's abundance is not only quantity but nourishment delivered without the ordinary route through labor and corruption.
